description: On the red bed in front of you are two small white drawer-like pieces: a taller boxy unit with a knob and open shelf, and a separate shallow drawer piece with a knob. The left hand steadies the taller unit in place while the right hand slides the shallow drawer piece leftward toward it, aligns it under the taller unit, and pushes it inward until it fits, then releases so the stacked drawer unit sits together.
